    Gooood Moooorning, Việt Nam!
    Welcome to Saigon (Ho Chi Minh City)!
    My name is Jason ‘Super Star’, and I’d love to help you experience the very best of southern Vietnam.
    I hold a Bachelor of Arts in English and have been guiding international visitors for more than 27 years. As an experienced freelance English-speaking guide, I specialise in private, personalised tours that showcase the authentic culture, history and flavours of Vietnam.
    Popular tours include:
    Saigon & Chinatown city tours
    Evening street food and foodie adventures
    Ben Duoc Original Củ Chi Tunnels (half-day)
    Mekong Delta ( Cái Bè Authentic day trip ) – a quieter, less touristy and non shopping experience
    Combined Củ Chi Tunnels & Mekong Delta day tour
    Overnight Mekong Delta tour including the famous Cai Rang Floating Market at sunrise
    Every tour is tailored to your interests, pace and travel style, ensuring a memorable and authentic experience.
    If you’d like to explore Vietnam with a knowledgeable local guide, I’d be delighted to help.

    Hi, Vietnam is a country with 3 regions with different cultures and beauty. You should explore all 3 regions of Vietnam, starting in Hanoi and ending in Saigon or vice versa.
    - Suggested itinerary to discover Vietnam : HCMC -Mekong delta-Cuchi tunnels- Danang-Hoian- Hanoi-Sapa-Tamcoc-Halong bay, moving in the city by private car or grab, moving between HCMC-Danang- Hanoi, use Sun airways or Vietnam airlines, exchange foreign currency at gold shops Use the Grab app to book a ride or order food delivery, join food tours in cities, delicious food. Have a nice trip.
